title: RAINIER: Reinforced Knowledge Introspector for Commonsense Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Manual qualitative annotation by NLP experts of generated knowledge statements to identify assumptions that are specific to certain cultures or geographical locations (e.g., Western, Christian, or US-centric norms).
Manual qualitative annotation of generated knowledge to identify statements that exhibit implicit bias or harmful stereotypes toward certain professions (e.g., doctors).
Manual qualitative annotation of generated knowledge to identify statements that impress bias against groups based on specific physical characteristics (e.g., 'ugly people').
